name: Implement mission new / expedition new commands (replace over-complicated mission create)
goal: Replace the draft-proposal mission create flow with a single canonicalizing 'mission new' (and 'expedition new') command, per the verb-consolidation plan. The new command should canonicalize a draft mission (emit MISSION_CREATED draft) so expeditions can be planned immediately, subsuming the 'mission create canonicalize draft' structural fix.
